test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom given below:
"Pound of flesh"

options.text: A harsh demand for rightful payment

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **A harsh demand for rightful payment**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Pound of flesh"** refers to a demand for something that is owed, even if it causes harm or difficulty to the debtor. (कठोर और अनुचित मांग, भले ही यह नुकसान पहुंचाए) • **Example:** The landlord’s insistence on collecting rent during the pandemic was like demanding a pound of flesh from struggling tenants. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: A fair and generous demand** (न्यायपूर्ण और उदार मांग): This option is incorrect because the idiom "pound of flesh" refers to an unfair and harsh demand, not a fair one. • **Example:** Asking for a fair share of profits is not equivalent to demanding a pound of flesh. • **Option 2: A symbolic compromise** (प्रतीकात्मक समझौता): This option is incorrect because "pound of flesh" conveys no sense of compromise; it is about strict and often unreasonable demands. • **Example:** Accepting a symbolic compromise is far from demanding a pound of flesh. • **Option 4: A gift given in return** (बदले में दिया गया उपहार): This option is incorrect because "pound of flesh" does not refer to any form of gift or goodwill gesture. • **Example:** A gift given in return is a kind act, unlike demanding a pound of flesh, which is harsh. 51:T1093, सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 3** अर्थात **सही भुगतान के लिए एक कठोर मांग**।
